name: Hasumi Ichino
source:
She is a charismatic student council president with good looks and excellent grades.

In contrast to her mature appearance, she is friendly and easygoing in word and actions. Basically, she is the type of leader who makes quick decisions and is always in the forefront waving the flag.

She is a leader who makes even the most uninteresting events into a fun and festive event. She is the “perfect student council president” who is trusted by the students.

She looks like a perfect superhero at first glance, but in her true nature, she is a lazy and spoiled child. She is best friends with Serina, the vice president, and in front of her, she is a spoiled and boorish person in her own right.

[From [url=https://www.pulltop.com/gp07/02_chara03-01.html]official site[/url]]
